subject: [PATCH 08/12] mm/collapse: separate scanning a PTE table from collapsing it

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch separates the scanning of a PTE table from collapsing it into two distinct functions: collapse_scan_pmd() and collapse_run_pmd(). The scan function reads the PTE table under mmap_lock to determine if the range is worth collapsing, while the run function performs the actual collapse. This change improves code organization and allows for better tracing and reporting of collapse operations.
